value.rationale: A natural full order-16 translation quotient of a canonical vertex-transitive strongly regular graph has a nonfree simplicial action. The previously known parent 23-sphere wedge does not determine the quotient, while the new quotient computation determines its entire homotopy type, integral homology and trivial π1. The explicit geometric quotient model with only two spheres is a motivated non-routine symmetry invariant.
